headline: Zhipu's flash model takes the crown; six new entrants shake things up
summary: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-20260826 vaulted to #1 with 15.4% share, dethroning yesterday's leader and marking a significant shift in the top tier. Six models debuted on the leaderboard today, including two fresh Xiaomi variants and OpenAI's gpt-6-luna. Meanwhile, six models dropped out entirely, including DeepSeek's v3.2 and Anthropic's claude-4.8-opus.
highlights: Zhipu AI's flash model claims the top spot at 15.4% token share, up 2 ranks in a week
DeepSeek and Zhipu AI combined hold 41.9% of all tokens across their portfolios
New entrants: Xiaomi mimo-v2.6 variants (ranks 22, 26), OpenAI gpt-6-luna (rank 42), Zhipu glm-5.3-flashx (rank 43), Qwen qwen3.8-max (rank 46), xAI grok-4.7 (rank 47)
Six models exited the top 51, including deepseek-v3.2 (last at rank 43) and anthropic claude-4.8-opus (last at rank 50)
DeepSeek provider share jumped 1.7% in one day to 23.3%, while Zhipu dropped 6.1% after its flash model's surge
Top 4 providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu, Tencent, OpenAI) control 64.8% of the market
